title: Harry Bot
description: Harry's slash commands, /junkstats Gemini ladder, and Fly machine health.

panels.title: Commands
panels.description: Slash commands run in the selected time range, including errors and cooldowns.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of commands that raised an unhandled error. A command that catches its own error and replies in Harry's voice counts as ok.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of successful commands across the selected range, estimated from histogram buckets.

panels.title: /junkstats answered
panels.description: Share of /junkstats requests where some Gemini model answered, instead of Harry apologizing.

panels.title: Memory (RSS)
panels.description: Harry's resident memory. The Fly machine has 512 MB.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Process restarts in the selected range. Deploys count too.

panels.title: Commands
panels.description: Commands run per interval, by command.

panels.title: Outcomes
panels.description: Commands per interval by outcome: ok, error (unhandled exception), or cooldown (rate-limited).

panels.title: p95 latency by command
panels.description: 95th percentile wall time of successful commands over a trailing window ($window). Harry's traffic is sparse, so a wider window gives smoother lines.

panels.title: Per-command summary
panels.description: Totals and latency for each command over the selected range. Latency covers successful runs only.

panels.title: Gemini attempts
panels.description: Every Gemini call /junkstats makes, by model and result: ok, timeout, or the HTTP status (429 = rate limited, 503 = overloaded). One request can try several models.

panels.title: Results by model
panels.description: Gemini calls per model and result over the selected range.

panels.title: /junkstats latency
panels.description: /junkstats wall time over a trailing window ($window). Dashed lines: 10 s is one model timing out; 30 s is every model timing out.

panels.title: Answer rate by model
panels.description: Share of each model's calls that returned an answer, over a trailing window ($window). A model stuck near 0 belongs lower in MODEL_LADDER or out of it.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (increase(harry_junkstats_attempts_total{app="$app",result="ok"}[$window])) or 0 * sum by (model) (increase(harry_junkstats_attempts_total{app="$app"}[$window]))) / sum by (model) (increase(harry_junkstats_attempts_total{app="$app"}[$window]))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Harry's resident memory against the machine's. Machine total is what the kernel reports for the 512 MB machine.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU use against the shared-CPU baseline. Fly counts CPU time in centiseconds, so its per-second rate reads as a percentage. Above the baseline, Harry spends burst balance.

panels.title: CPU burst balance and throttling
panels.description: Burst balance (left, seconds; a shared CPU caps it at 500 s) and the share of time Fly throttled the CPU (right). Throttling starts when the balance reaches zero.

panels.title: Cache volume (/data)
panels.description: Space used on the harry_data_cache volume, where bigleague keeps its Statcast parquet cache, Bloom filter and player register.
